exposure: Pfannenstiel skin incision plus an upper transverse lower uterine segment (LUS) incision (transverse-transverse)
Infra-umbilical midline abdominal incision and a midline uterine incision (vertical-vertical)
cohort: 116 women diagnosed with morbidly adherent placenta (MAP)
finding: In women with MAP, the transverse-transverse incision resulted in less bleeding, reduced blood product use, and better cosmetic outcomes compared to the vertical-vertical incision.
